name: proctora-ecosystem
description: Multi-Modal AI-Powered Remote Exam Proctoring System with Dual-Camera Real-Time Verification

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend-student install && npm --prefix frontend-admin install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "AI,BACKEND,STUDENT,ADMIN" -c "yellow,cyan,blue,magenta" "npm run ai:server" "npm run backend" "npm run student:desktop" "npm run admin"
scripts.dev:web: npx concurrently -n "AI,BACKEND,STUDENT,ADMIN" -c "yellow,cyan,blue,magenta" "npm run ai:server" "npm run backend" "npm run student:web" "npm run admin"
